scope: Integrative / Functional Medicine (MD, DO, NP, PA, RN)
short: Thrive Health & Wellness is a virtual functional health practice dedicated to helping women uncover the root causes of their health concerns, including autoimmunity, thyroid dysfunction, hormonal imbalances, digestive issues, and fatigue. We take a personalized, root-cause approach using functional lab testing, nutrition, lifestyle modifications, stress management, and targeted supplementation to support the body's natural ability to heal and help women feel their best. We offer virtual functional health consultations and personalized health programs to our patients.
training: Family nurse practitioner, primary care, functional health
long: Welcome to Thrive Health & Wellness in Powhatan, VA. Led by Family Nurse Practitioner Suzanne Paul, our mission is to help you break free from a broken healthcare system that just manages symptoms with band-aid prescriptions. We do things differently. By finding the root cause of your chronic conditions, we create customized plans using natural methods to heal your body from the inside out. We specialize in treating gut issues, fatigue, thyroid disorders, autoimmune conditions, and weight loss resistance. If you're ready to get off the medication wheel, our dedicated team is here to help you take control of your health. It's your turn to THRIVE!
